input.text: Article 11 of the Treaty establishing the Example Community and Article 14 thereof apply.

references.literal: Article 11 of the Treaty establishing the Example Community

_note: 'and' is a treaty-name continuation connector (:data:`_TREATY_CONTINUATION_UNIT`), and 'Article' is Title-Case; the name must stop before 'and Article'/'and Articles', never swallowing it into the treaty's own name and merging the second citation into the first.
